Thirty-Third Sunday in Ordinary Time The readings today emphasise fidelity and dedication to duty and work.
It is more blessed to give: talents and gifts are given for the service of the community.
The Christian is to be fully dedicated to working in service of others while watching and waiting for the life to come.
There is always so much good to be done for others and so little time in which to do it!
